result.note: Brief bilateral defence item; tested only the meeting's sequence and the areas of cooperation agreed.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the India–Rwanda defence joint committee meeting held in July 2026:
items: It was the first meeting of the two countries' defence joint committee.
The two sides agreed to widen their defence partnership across military training, joint exercises and defence industries.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because the meeting on 8 July 2026 was the second meeting of the joint committee, not the first. At that meeting the two countries agreed to broaden cooperation across training, exercises and defence industries.
questions.source: India and Rwanda agreed to widen their defence partnership across military training, joint exercises, and defence industries at their second joint committee meeting.
